meta.title: HAZOP and LOPA of the R-101 unit
meta.scope: From the demineralised-water, PVA, VCM and initiator charges into R-101, through the reaction with its jacket loop, baffles and reflux condenser E-101, to the short-stop, relief, degassing to VCM recovery and discharge to D-102, including utilities (cooling water, LP steam, N₂, instrument air, electrical power) and the batch procedures.
meta.objective: Identify the hazards and operability problems of the unit, judge their risk, and decide what must be added or changed. For the scenarios that need more than the existing safeguards, check the risk reduction by LOPA.
meta.assump: The unit is operated by trained staff at the design conditions. Nitrogen, instrument air and power are available at start-up. Instruments and relief valves are tested on the plan in the maintenance procedure.
meta.protocol: Method: HAZOP to IEC 61882 with full recording. The team takes one node at a time, states its design intent, and applies the guide words to each parameter to find deviations. For each deviation it records the causes, the events that follow, the consequences without credit for safeguards, the existing safeguards, and the risk after safeguards (S × L). Rows above the tolerable level go to LOPA in the same worksheet: initiating-event frequency, enabling conditions and conditional modifiers, independent protection layers with their PFD, and the mitigated frequency compared with the tolerable event likelihood for the severity. Open points go to the Parking Lot; actions become recommendations with an owner and a due date.

N1.causes:
XV-101 or FV-101 fails closed
demineralised-water supply lost
FQI-101 preset left at zero
N1.cons: Batch cannot start; cycle time lost (operability only)

N1.causes:
FQI-101 preset entered too high
totaliser miscounts
XV-101 fails to close at the preset
N1.cons: Reactor overfilled: after VCM and heating the vapour space vanishes, liquid reaches E-101 and the vessel can go liquid-full → hydraulic overpressure

N1.causes:
FQI-101 preset low
header pressure low and the charge stopped early
N1.cons: Higher solids and viscosity, lower jacket heat transfer, hotter batch, more lumps
VCM flashes when charged, pressure rises early; heat-up faster (small effect)

N1.dev: Only part of the PVA reaches the reactor
N1.causes:
HV-107 opened late or not at all
PVA pot not refilled
wrong concentration
N1.cons: Unstable suspension: droplets coalesce, lumps grow, agitator power and wall fouling rise, jacket U falls; bottom valve may block at discharge

N1.dev: Dissolved oxygen or air with the charge
N1.causes:
Water not de-aerated
air drawn in through the charge line
N1.cons: Induction period (oxygen inhibits), inerts that later blanket E-101, polyperoxide formation

N1.causes:
Raw or softened water instead of demineralised
iron or chloride carry-over
N1.cons: Fouling and off-colour PVC, porosity out of specification (quality)

N1.dev: Reactor contents back into the water header
N1.causes: XV-101 and FV-101 passing while R-101 runs at 8.6 bar g, above the header pressure
N1.cons: VCM enters the demineralised-water system and is released at other users (exposure, fire)
